description: This file defines the internal class RequestWorkItem which inherits from WorkItemBase. It represents a unit of work related to handling a request message in the Orleans runtime scheduler, encapsulating a message and a target, and providing methods for execution and formatting.

classes.name: RequestWorkItem
classes.description: Internal sealed class representing a request processing unit within the Orleans runtime scheduler. It holds a request message and a target, providing execution and formatting capabilities.

methods.name: RequestWorkItem
methods.description: Constructor initializing the target and request message.

methods.name: Name
methods.description: Override property returning a string identifying the work item by its request ID.

methods.name: GrainContext
methods.description: Override property returning the grain context (target) associated with this work item.

methods.name: Execute
methods.description: Override method that executes the work item by invoking the target to handle the new request.

methods.name: TryFormat
methods.description: Override method to format the work item details into a span of characters, including request info.
